text: Seabrook Town stepped up their game at 65 minutes, pressing higher and attacking more directly to chase the 2-1 scoreline against Harbour City [#1361]. Meanwhile, Harbour City’s chances improved slightly, showing that Seabrook’s gamble opened up space for their opponents too [#1361]. Overall, it's a bold move that changed the flow but hasn’t yet paid off in goals.
